entries.title: I Corinthians 5:1
segments: ¶It is actually reported [that there is] sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles--that a man has his father's wife!

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:2
segments: And you are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he who has done this deed might be taken away from among you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:3
segments: For I indeed, as absent in body but present in spirit, have already judged (as though I were present) him who has so done this deed.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:4
segments: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together, along with my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:5
segments: deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that his spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:6
segments: Your glorying [is] not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:7
segments: ¶Therefore purge out the old leaven, that you may be a new lump, since you truly are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, was sacrificed for us.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:8
segments: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened [bread] of sincerity and truth.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:9
segments: ¶I wrote to you in my epistle not to keep company with sexually immoral people.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:10
segments: Yet [I] certainly [did] not [mean] with the sexually immoral people of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or idolaters, since then you would need to go out of the world.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:11
segments: But now I have written to you not to keep company with anyone named a brother, who is sexually immoral, or covetous, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner--not even to eat with such a person.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:12
segments: For what [have] I [to do] with judging those also who are outside? Do you not judge those who are inside?

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:13
segments: But those who are outside God judges. Therefore "put away from yourselves the evil person."
